subject: Urgent: Exec clearance for above-baseline Hosted API concession (HealthLayer)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: exec clearance for above-baseline Hosted API concession (HealthLayer)

Team — looping you in for quick clearance on a time-sensitive concession request from HealthLayer. Key facts up front:
- Account: HealthLayer (AI-assisted medical records).
- Ask: 30% off standard Hosted API usage pricing on a 24-month committed usage agreement.
- Proposed commercial terms: 24-month MRC with a $150k minimum monthly commitment for year 1, then step-down if utilization tracked; Cap on total tokens/month defined in SOW.
- Rationale: strategic anchor partner for our healthcare integrations marketplace; strong reference potential; they will onboard a pilot 3 customers in Q4 and have marketplace listing priority if we support the pricing.
- Risk/impact: revenue dilution vs list is material (~30% blended reduction), but we expect high volume and retention; see attached pricing model for P&L sensitivity.

Ask: need exec clearance to offer 30% concession and confirm any conditions (prepay, billing cadence, audit terms). I can present the final concession to the customer as soon as we have confirmation.

Attachments: HealthLayer_Pricing_Model.xlsx, HL_Statement_of_Work_v3.pdf

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
m: 415-555-0194
[Attachment: HealthLayer_Pricing_Model.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: HL_Statement_of_Work_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-09-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exec clearance for above-baseline Hosted API concession (HealthLayer)

+1 to Monica's summary. HealthLayer is asking to be competitive with a vendor who quoted deeper list cuts but less reliable SLA/observability. If we can secure the 24-month commit and early onboarding milestone payments, this is a strategic win for the marketplace.

One operational ask: insist on a usage floor and quarterly usage reporting. Otherwise we risk exposure if they underutilize. Happy to push for that in the SOW.

Ben
Ben Carter | Head of Strategic Accounts

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: exec clearance for above-baseline Hosted API concession (HealthLayer)

Thanks for the concise brief, Monica. I support moving on a strategic concession here. I can authorize up to a 25% concession immediately for an anchor partner, provided the following conditions are met:
- 24-month term with minimum monthly commitment of at least $120k in year 1 (preferably $150k).
- 6-month prepay or first-quarter upfront payment to mitigate churn risk.
- SLA and audit clauses preserved; Redwood retains right to revert pricing if abusive usage patterns are detected.

If the team believes 30% is essential to secure the marketplace commitment, Laura please confirm whether finance can sign off to extend to 30% with the proposed payment conditions and whether we need CFO-level approval. If yes, include any additional guardrails (cap on total discounts, escalation triggers).

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer
[Quoted]
> On 2028-09-30 09:12, Monica Patel wrote:
> Team — looping you in for quick clearance...

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-30T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exec clearance for above-baseline Hosted API concession (HealthLayer)

Reviewed the attached pricing model and revenue impact. Finance is comfortable with a 30% concession under strict conditions to protect cash flow and limit downside:
- Require 6-month prepayment (applied as credit over first 6 months) OR an irrevocable letter of credit for the first 6 months.
- Minimum monthly recurring commitment of $150k in year 1; quarterly usage audits and right to claw back discounts for non-compliance.
- Discount allowed only on Hosted API usage (tokens). No discount on professional services, concierge onboarding fees, or third-party marketplace fees.
- Add a 6-month price protection carve-out so we can renegotiate if cost per token rises due to infra changes.

If these conditions are added to the SOW and we get a signed DocuSign, finance will approve the 30% concession. I've included a redlined revenue sensitivity in the attached spreadsheet.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance
[Attachment: HealthLayer_Pricing_Model.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@healthlayer.ai>, HealthLayer Procurement <procurement@healthlayer.ai>

Date: 2028-09-30T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Final - Exec clearance for Hosted API concession (HealthLayer)

Aisha — good news. Internal approvals complete and finance has signed off on the 30% hosted-usage concession subject to the following binding conditions: 

1) 24-month Master Services Agreement and SOW executed via DocuSign.
2) Minimum Monthly Commitment (MMC) of $150k for year 1 (billing monthly).
3) 6-month prepayment applied as credit to first 6 months OR an irrevocable LOC for the same period.
4) Discount applies only to Hosted API usage (token usage). No discounts on professional services or marketplace fees.
5) Quarterly usage audits; Redwood retains right to claw back discounts for sustained non-compliance.
6) Price-protection clause allowing Redwood to reopen pricing if per-token infra costs increase materially.

Attached: updated SOW and the pricing model. If you can confirm acceptance of the conditions, I will route the DocuSign for signatures tonight and provision the marketplace listing on execution.

Appreciate the partnership — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
